subject: Engagement pathway: weekly nudge and updated MAP draft
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex G. <alex.g@zenithops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed engagement pathway (draft MAP)

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same view: 

Summary of needs
- Low-latency inference for document search and chat (pilot: 50 QPS, production: 200 QPS)
- Enterprise controls: SSO (SAML), audit logs, configurable data retention
- SLA target: 99.9% for user-facing endpoints

Proposed milestones (draft MAP)
1) Pilot kickoff: env prep + baseline tests — owner: ZenithOps infra (target: 2026-10-18)
2) Security & architecture review — owner: Redwood (Ben) + ZenithOps Sec (target: 2026-10-22)
3) Pilot validation & performance tuning — owner: Redwood (Maya) (target: 2026-11-01)
4) Procurement & contract signature — owner: ZenithOps procurement (Priya) (target: 2026-11-07)
5) Prod roll (reserved capacity) — owner: Redwood Ops (target: 2026-11-21)

Dependencies / blockers
- Security questionnaire & evidence (ZenithOps needs SOC2 evidence for hosting + network diagram)
- Procurement timeline (internal approvals at ZenithOps)
- SSO integration details (metadata + test account)

Immediate next steps
- Ben: schedule the security architecture review (Ben, can you propose 2 slots next week?).
- Alex: confirm procurement contact and preferred contract cadence (single-year vs. auto-renew).
- Priya: if you want, I can circulate a lean SOW and estimate to make approvals faster.

I attached a one-page "engagement_pathway_v1" table below — I'll generate a clean MAP spreadsheet after you confirm the procurement timeline. If the target close looks tight, we can shift the procurement target by one week (no problem) but would like to lock the pilot window.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.ai

Attachment: engagement_pathway_v1.xlsx (summary table stub)

From: Alex G. <alex.g@zenithops.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <ps@zenithops.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed engagement pathway (draft MAP)

Thanks, Maya — clear and helpful. A few quick items from our side: 

- Procurement: looping in Priya (cc) — Priya, we typically need a statement of work + security artifacts before we can route to legal/finance. Targeting internal approvals in early November unless we can accelerate.
- Security: the SOC2 evidence + network diagram are table stakes. I attached our internal security checklist to this reply for your reference (see zenithops_security_requirements.pdf).
- SSO: we prefer SAML; will share metadata once we get final approval from identity team.

If it's possible to move the security review up to next week (even a 60-min technical review), that would help shorten the procurement cycle. Ben — are you able to take that?

Appreciate the path; a 11/07 target for procurement looks reasonable but contingent on the security review moving sooner.

—Alex
Alex G.
Head of Platform, ZenithOps
alex.g@zenithops.com

Attachment: zenithops_security_requirements.pdf

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex G. <alex.g@zenithops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <ps@zenithops.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed engagement pathway (updated MAP v2)

Thanks Alex — appreciated, and thanks for the checklist (handy). Per your ask, I pushed the security review earlier in the timeline and drafted an updated MAP (attached: engagement_pathway_v2.xlsx). Highlights / edits from v1: 

- Security review moved to 2026-10-08 (Ben to lead).
- Procurement target remains 2026-11-07 but flagged as "at risk" if evidence delivery slips.
- Added explicit test account owner (ZenithOps identity group) and SSO metadata deadline (2026-10-12).
- Added a short dependency column (who needs to supply what): e.g., network diagram (ZenithOps), test SAML metadata (ZenithOps), SOC2 report (Redwood).

Inline milestone table (condensed):
- Pilot kickoff — 2026-10-18 — Owner: ZenithOps infra
- Security review (scheduled) — 2026-10-08 — Owner: Redwood (Ben) + ZenithOps Sec
- Pilot validation — 2026-11-01 — Owner: Redwood (Maya)
- Procurement signature — 2026-11-07 — Owner: ZenithOps (Priya)

Action items (this week)
- Ben: confirm security review slot and agenda (60 min, include infra and appsec).
- Alex: share SAML metadata or a test account by 2026-10-12.
- Priya: any constraints on PO language / net-30 vs net-45?

Note: I attached the MAP spreadsheet and a one-page SOW excerpt in the Drive link below for easier review. If you prefer, I can convert the MAP to a single-slide timeline for your CFO.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/zenithops-engagement-pathway-v2

Thanks — looping Ben to confirm the security review slot.

Best,
Maya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: engagement_pathway_v2.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex G. <alex.g@zenithops.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <ps@zenithops.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed engagement pathway (updated MAP v2)

Thanks — scheduled a 60-minute security & architecture review for 2026-10-08 at 3:00 PM PT. Agenda: environment topology, access model (SAML), data handling, audit logs.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
